services.desc: You’ve come to the right place to rent a pontoon and cruise the beautiful emerald coast! There is so much to see and explore, be sure to bring your camera to capture your memories! Mid-Bay Watersports has the perfect central Destin location where you won’t get caught up in the harbor congestion, giving you more time to enjoy your rental. Go west to soak up the sun on Crab Island, cruise the harbor, explore the fingers of Holiday Isle, or head toward Okaloosa Island and Fort Walton Beach to sightsee or anchor up on the many miles of Gulf Shore National Seashore.
